title: Steam Achievement Sets: Valve splits up 100% runs 🏆
subject: steam
description:
Would sets make you go for 100% more often? 👇

Valve added Steam Achievement Sets to the Steam Client Beta on October 15, 2026. Developers can group achievements into sets with their own progress bars, DLC sets only count once you own the content, and archived achievements no longer block completion. 17 games already use it, including Portal 2, Team Fortress 2 and Forza Horizon 5.

Sources: Steam Client Beta update notes and Steam announcement (Oct 15, 2026), Video Games Chronicle (Oct 16, 2026), Gaming.net
